info.name: Get detailed information about a specific array including all values and type-specific properties.

params.name: arrayId
params.description: The unique identifier of the array to retrieve.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns array details with properties varying based on the array type:
            
- **Static Arrays**: Returns a list of string values in order
- **Product Output Grouping Arrays**: Returns the product output grouping ID
- **Calculated Range Arrays**: Returns start/end/step value configurations (variable, constant, or time index)
- **Data Table Arrays**: Returns the data table variable name and calculation level

info.name: Update the values in a static array.

params.name: ArrayId
params.description: The ID of the static array to update.

items.docs:
This endpoint can be used to replace all existing values in a static array.
            
All values must be unique and non-empty. Each value can be up to 200 characters.
